verdict.rationale: Kong's Dev Portal publishes APIs from OpenAPI or AsyncAPI specifications plus Markdown documentation, which covers the spec-to-docs story. Published docs are browsable and searchable, operations can be tried, and visibility can be public or private with authentication. missing for 10: generating docs from collections (only specs are evidenced), detail on how docs are rendered from a spec and how automated publishing works, independent or hands-on corroboration.
